propositions: A [operator-attested] tag on code-verifiable acceptance criteria with repository path/symbol evidence passed plan-review guards and reached the completion verifier, defeating layered defense against attestation laundering.

The evidence-kind criterion ran but missed flagging a tagged AC citing exact test file paths (tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py), and det_measurement_provenance detected missing provenance lines but was wired as advisory, allowing the tag to pass.

New deterministic close-path guard det_attestation_launder.py blocks [operator-attested] ACs containing repo path/symbol citations before verifier runs, with precision matchers for test paths, code extensions, and pytest node IDs.

Close-precheck guard txn.ensure_attested_items_valid promotes provenance-line validation to blocking on close path only, distinguishing legitimate external evidence (with provenance) from code-verifiable criteria misclassified as operator-attested.

Mixed-evidence ACs (repo citation + external outcome) now fire under per-line evidence-vs-orientation rules; test-shaped citations always fire; other repo citations fire only with evidence-introducing keywords, coaching authors to split criteria.
